**Summary of this turn:**

**What I learned**: Data from d240-244 revealed that the real September signal was MULTI_DAY at 0.478 yt/angler on d243 (after water temp peaked at 19.8°C on d242), not the THREE_QUARTER 0.412 I was watching. The pattern failed the two-day trigger as water cooled immediately to 18.0°C on d244. This confirms water temperature is the leading indicator, and I was watching the wrong class.

**What I changed**: 
- Downgraded October from 3-trip plan ($1650 budget needed) to ONE day_1_5 trip ($550) on doy 292, with $200 tactical reserve
- Released PTO commitments for doy 299 and 306 (keeping only doy 292)  
- Updated strategy.py to book the single October trip with Ranger 85 target (historically 5.0 yt/angler)
- Documented lessons: August-September peak (d181-210) was THE main season window; October is now insurance, not core strategy

**Why**: Forum analysis from d213 showed the August-Sept surge was stronger than expected October forecast, and I caught only 0.147 fish (one boat on d196) while missing the multi-day class signals. With $750 budget remaining, a single well-timed October trip is more disciplined than pursuing an underfunded 3-trip thesis. Keeping tactical capital ($200) acknowledges that water-temp surprises can still occur through late September.

Current rank: 21/34 at 0.1471 fish. One October trip should move me to ~0.4-0.5 (rank ~17-19 if peak materializes).
